name: agent-standup
title: Agent Standup
description: See which of your Claude Code, Codex and Mistral Vibe sessions need you, from the menu bar, and open them as a live team call.
author: atoll92

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Agents in Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Agent Standup
commands.description: How many of your agent sessions need you and how many are working, in the menu bar.

commands.name: sessions
commands.title: Agent Sessions
commands.subtitle: Agent Standup
commands.description: The Claude Code, Codex, Mistral Vibe and Cowork sessions on this Mac: who needs you, who is working, whose turn it is.

commands.name: open-call
commands.title: Open the Standup
commands.subtitle: Agent Standup
commands.description: Open the live call of your agents in your browser.

preferences.name: showTitles
preferences.title: Session Titles
preferences.label: Show session titles and questions
preferences.description: Show each session's title and what it asks you. Off: only projects, states and counts.

preferences.name: npxPath
preferences.title: npx Path
preferences.description: Full path to npx, if it is not found on its own (Homebrew, nvm, fnm, Volta, asdf and mise are looked for).

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
